description: Run the §3.2 static gate against the INSTALLED native workflow scripts: meta first, name equals file stem, phases agree, no forbidden or resume-breaking construct, parses as a module body.
why: tests/native-workflows-drift.test.cjs pins the source. This checks the copies Claude Code actually loads, after the installer wrote them — the only way to catch a write that truncated or altered a script.

steps.why: The checker prints {checked, problems}. Four scripts checked, zero problems — and `problems` must be PRESENT so an empty output cannot pass.
